guidelines.text: Count what the question names before you choose. One animal named is a profile; two animals named is a comparison, even when it asks which of the two is faster or stronger; a superlative — the fastest, the biggest, the deadliest — is a ranking; a place is a place. Choose the one block that shape belongs to and stop there. A place is the only shape that takes two blocks, because it is both what the place is and what lives in it. Never the same block twice, and never a block added because it could be filled.
Every round ends with the follow-up questions. They are never the block you stop before.
The written answer is the fallback: it carries the round only when no other block fits, and never sits above a block that already answers the question.
